title: introduce-prefill-safeguard-cost-calculator-and-quant-fx
author: Diego Martinez
description:
Context and motivation:
This change introduces a prefill safeguard layer and a compact quantization fallback ("quant-fx") that together reduce unexpected cost overruns caused by aggressive prefill + quant combos in tail workloads. Several customers hit scenario where aggressive 4-bit presets + prefill heuristics produced regressions in unit economics for low-throughput tenants. The goal is to add a safety net that: (1) estimates per-request cost delta for a prefill decision, (2) applies a conservative fallback quant profile when predicted unit econ crosses a tenant-configurable threshold, and (3) exposes a small operator CLI to inspect and simulate decisions for troubleshooting.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds an online Prefill Safeguard Cost Calculator that computes expected token-cost delta and an associated risk score derived from recent token distribution and KV cache hit ratios.
- Implements Quant-FX: a thin runtime hook that can switch between quant profiles (8-bit->4-bit or 4-bit->8-bit) for a single request when the safeguard deems the expected cost/regression unacceptable. This is implemented as a lightweight runtime hint (no cold-restart).
- Adds a CLI (prefillctl) for operators to run dry-run simulations against a tenant's recent traffic, and a --what-if flag to show estimated cost delta for different quant profiles.
- Adds telemetry metrics: econ.prefill.estimated_delta_usd, econ.prefill.risk_score, econ.quantfx.fallback_count, and prefillctl CLI events.
- Provides unit tests and integration smoke tests; docs for ops and a short quickstart.

Checklist:
- [x] Safeguard algorithm implementation and hooks in serving runtime
- [x] Quant-FX runtime fallback implementation (patch-level, non-disruptive)
- [x] Operator CLI and dry-run mode
- [x] Telemetry metrics and dashboard skeleton (Grafana JSON in docs)
- [x] Unit & integration tests
- [x] Documentation for on-call and SRE runbook

High level changes (files):
- src/econ/safeguard_calculator.py: main algorithm + tenant config lookup
- src/runtime/quant_fx.py: runtime hint handler, lightweight switch logic + fallbacks
- cli/prefillctl.py: operator CLI to simulate and inspect decisions, supports --tenant, --lookback and --what-if args
- telemetry/metrics.yaml: metric definitions and dashboard skeleton used by Console
- docs/ops/prefill-safeguards.md: ops runbook and rollout notes
- tests/unit/test_safeguard.py: unit coverage for edge cases (zero-prefill, extreme-long tails)
- tests/integration/test_quantfx_smoke.py: integration smoke test against local runtime simulator

Commits (summary):
- 0c1e5a2: introduce safeguard calculator core and tenant thresholds + config parsing
- 1a9b4d7: wire Quant-FX runtime hook and add lightweight runtime switch APIs
- 2f7b8c0: add CLI prefillctl with dry-run and what-if simulation paths
- 3b4c6d1: add telemetry metrics + Grafana skeleton + docs draft
- 4d8f9e2: unit/integration tests, fix flake found in CI

Testing and verification:
- Local unit test suite passes (tests/unit/*) with coverage for risk bucketing and fallback decisions.
- Integration smoke used runtime simulator to verify quant-fx fallback does not require model reload and has sub-1ms decision overhead in hot path (measured in dev environment).
- Ran prefillctl --what-if against a sampled tenant trace (1k requests) and validated cost delta estimates matched simulated accounting within 3%.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main as feature-flagged off by default.
2) Enable for internal staging tenants and run prefillctl campaigns for 48h.
3) If results are within thresholds, enable for a subset of low-throughput tenants with opt-in.
4) Iterate on thresholds and expose per-tenant override in Console.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: quant-fx runtime switching could introduce regressions in output quality for edge cases. Mitigation: fallback is gated by risk_score and tenant opt-in; we log samples for quality evals and throttle fallbacks to <1% of traffic for first week.
- Risk: inaccurate cost estimator may oscillate. Mitigation: estimator contains smoothing over 1-hr windows and conservative bias; operator CLI allows dry-run verification before enabling.

Notes for reviewers:
- Focus review on: correctness of cost delta math in safeguard_calculator.py, lightweightness of runtime hook in quant_fx.py, and that prefillctl does not leak sensitive traces (we only surface derived metrics unless --export-samples is explicitly provided).

Related work:
- Builds on ideas from ENG-2981 (prefill economics explorer) and uses sampling plumbing added in ENG-3050.
